get_threshold_fns: get threshold calibration and prediction functions for conformal prediction with a given confidence level alpha
get_raps_fns: get RAPS calibration and prediction functions with configurable regularization parameters k_reg and lambda_reg
get_groups: get class group arrays for datasets like mnist, cifar10, or cifar100 using identity, singleton, or groups keys
evaluate_coverage: evaluate marginal and class-conditional coverage of predicted confidence sets against ground truth labels
evaluate_conformal_prediction: run multiple trials of conformal prediction evaluation with random train-test splits and return mean and std metrics
